name: Number One
source:
Top detective of the World Detective Organization.
He is almost never seen in public and his true identity is unknown. The detectives refer to him only by the nickname Number One.
He gives orders to the detectives in Kanai Ward via a direct line from headquarters.
[From [url=https://www.spike-chunsoft.co.jp/raincode/en/character/]official website[/url]

[spoiler]He is eventually revealed to be a body double for [url=https://vndb.org/c128822]the actual Number One[/url]. The body double appeared to be killed during a bombing on the World Detective Organization headquarters through news footage, but it was revealed in the Epilogue that the news footage was fake and created by [url=https://vndb.org/c128821]Makoto[/url]. [/spoiler]
